rationale: Softpseudo_clean_diff is the only 5/5-fold family with huge nested OOF (+11.63e-5 at w=0.040). Full injection is ~2.7e-4 from St9 — too far vs proven 0.11–0.51e-4 window — so lead with 0.40x (SlotA), step to 0.55x (SlotB) if A gains, then soft+cont (SlotE) for LB gradient. SlotF tests Soft+IDF mid-scale. SlotC/H are safe fallbacks; SlotD is full push.

submit_cmds.slotA: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotA_softpseudo_x040.csv -m "Day2 SlotA: St9(0.95330)+0.40*SoftPseudoDiff orth"
submit_cmds.slotB: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotB_softpseudo_x055.csv -m "Day2 SlotB: St9+0.55*SoftPseudoDiff"
submit_cmds.slotC: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotC_softpseudo_x025.csv -m "Day2 SlotC: St9+0.25*SoftPseudoDiff safe"
submit_cmds.slotD: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotD_softpseudo_x100.csv -m "Day2 SlotD: St9+1.0*SoftPseudoDiff full"
submit_cmds.slotE: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotE_soft_x0p40_plus_cont.csv -m "Day2 SlotE: St9+0.40*Soft+0.35*(St9-St8)"
submit_cmds.slotF: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotF_soft_idf_x0p40.csv -m "Day2 SlotF: St9+0.40*(Soft+IDF)"
submit_cmds.slotG: kaggle competitions submit -c playground-series-s6e11 -f submissions/sub_day2_slotG_soft_graph_x0p40.csv -m "Day2 SlotG: St9+0.40*(Soft+Graph)"
